name: Time Span Selector
tagline: A highly customizable, elegant Android library for selecting time durations with Radial and Linear designs.
description:
A highly customizable, elegant Android library for selecting time durations. Featuring both Circular (Radial) and Linear designs with full Material 3 support.

Library Features

🕒 Dual Layouts

Includes both Circular (clock-like) and Linear (slider-like) selectors to fit any application design or UX requirement.

🌓 Overnight Support

Seamlessly handles spans that cross midnight. Perfect for sleep trackers, work shifts, and flexible alarm settings.

🚀 Implementation Guide

Step 1: Add Dependency

Add JitPack repository to build file and include implementation line in app-level build.gradle.

Step 2: Declare in XML

Add CircularTimeSpanSelector or LinearTimeSpanSelector to layout file with desired attributes.

Step 3: Style with Attributes

Use app:tss_spanColor, app:tss_trackWidth, and app:tss_is24HourFormat to customize appearance.

Step 4: Handle Listeners

Implement OnSpanChangeListener in Activity or Fragment for real-time interaction updates.
